data.one_liner: HyperVerge SDK for document capture, face recognition, and QR/barcode scanning.
data.what_it_does: HyperSnapSDK provides out-of-the-box UI flows to scan documents, face capture with liveness detection, and barcode scanning. It streamlines capturing images at resolutions optimized for HyperVerge AI engines.
use_when: You need identity verification (eKYC) flows including document OCR and face liveness detection.
You need to scan barcodes or QR codes in a Flutter application.
avoid_when: You only need a simple basic camera preview without AI or OCR pipelines.
You want an open-source or fully customizable camera interface without relying on proprietary native SDK bins.
strengths: Includes advanced AI-based liveness checks and anti-spoofing algorithms.
Simplifies integration with HyperVerge's backend OCR and face recognition services.
weaknesses: Relies on proprietary native SDKs with specific build configurations (like custom Maven repositories and Proguard rules).
Limited documentation inside the public plugin README regarding full configuration classes.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android minSDK 19+, multidex, custom Maven repository URL in build.gradle, Proguard rule updates, and iOS camera usage description in info.plist.
